text:
sarah.dev: Heads-up — deploybot flagged a p95 latency spike on /v1/generate in prod-usw2 at 12:38 UTC. Deploybot suggests auto-revert to v2.3.1 :rotating_light:

deploybot: [ALERT] route=/v1/generate env=prod-usw2 p95=2.2s threshold=1.5s action=suggest_autorevert reason=kv-cache-evictions

michael.rl: Copy. Any customer-visible errors or just latency noise?

sarah.dev: Error rate up ~0.4% (5xx). A few timeouts in logs referencing kvcache miss + oom-ish logs on worker-7. Not widespread but correlated with last config push (kernel flag A/B).

lina-oncall: I'm +1 to manual rollback instead of letting autorevert run. We don't want flip-flop if it's config-related. Who can pin the release?

ash.platform: I can pin, but need the rollback command. Also we should notify Dedicated customers first.

michael.rl: Manual rollback plan: 1) pin traffic to v2.3.0 (previous stable) 2) run rollback job for affected pool 3) watch p95 & 5xx for 15m 4) if stable, update release notes + send customer blurb.

release-bot: runbook: rollback-service --env prod-usw2 --pool infer-usw2 --to v2.3.0 --drain 120

sarah.dev: Command to execute (ops): `./tools/rollout rollback-service --env=prod-usw2 --pool=infer-usw2 --to=v2.3.0 --grace-period=120`

lina-oncall: I'm on the bridge. Ash, can you pin the version in console now? I'll throttle traffic to 0.

ash.platform: Pin done (console request id c9f3). Throttling traffic slice -> 0 for v2.4.0. Kicking rollback job now.

release-bot: rollback-job started id=rb-20260305-001. Notifying stakeholders channel=general and support-inbox.

michael.rl: Draft for customer blurb: "We observed increased latency on a recent rollout and are reverting to a stable version while we investigate. No data was exposed; we’ll follow up with details and ETA for fix." Approve?

sarah.dev: Approve. Add ETA: we expect to have root cause triaged within 4 hours; full postmortem in 48h.

lina-oncall: Rollback progress: drain started on 8/12 nodes, 45s average connection close. p95 trending down to 1.1s. 5xx at 0.05%.

ash.platform: Rollback job finished, rollout complete. All traffic now on v2.3.0.

release-bot: job rb-20260305-001 status=success end_ts=1769004518

michael.rl: Good. Action items: - Create postmortem ticket (owner: sarah.dev) - Add kernel-flag A/B to canary gate - Update release notes to mention rollback and impacted routes - Notify Dedicated customers (support to send blurb)

sarah.dev: I'll open the PM ticket and drop initial notes. Lina, can you keep monitoring for 30m then hand off to day SRE?

lina-oncall: Will do. Monitoring in progress, will ping when handoff ready. :thumbsup:

ash.platform: Also following up to roll forward guard: disable auto-autorevert for this rollout window to prevent double flips.

michael.rl: Thanks team. Closing this thread once postmortem ticket and customer blurb done.

sarah.dev: Posted ticket https://internal.pmo/PM-4212 and pushed a short release-note update to drafts. Support taking the blurb to customers now.

lina-oncall: Handoff to day SRE in 32m, metrics stable. Thread closed once support confirms customer messages sent. :white_check_mark:
